acceptance: A batch whose members were prepared at successive heads passes readiness (fails on current code).
A stale receipt, a missing overlap rerun, or a final head not bound in the tracker is refused.
A develop-merge refresh passes, and its develop changes are not counted as member changes.
pr_arm refuses an integration-branch PR without current batch acceptance and arms one with it; an ordinary PR's arming path is unchanged (test).
Merged to develop, after a benchbox-oracle success review of its head if it touches soundness paths.
context: Decision gate: start only after benchbox-todo-db-batch-v2-runtime-20261101 and pr-landing-soundness-refusal-unreachable-20261009 are done. pr-landing-soundness-refusal-unreachable-20261009 records the soundness direction: pr_landing's ready path defers to the required oracle check, as pr_arm.py does. Its text names oracle-review; since 2026-10-24 the required check is oracle-gate (_project/decisions/oracle-review-check-retired-2026-10-24.md). Guardrails: deliver as an ordinary serial PR to develop (AGENTS.md: feature delivery cannot deliver the changes that make it possible); write only from a linked worktree made with make worktree-create and checked with make agent-write-preflight, never the primary clone; stage explicit paths, never git add -A; no explanatory comments or docstrings (COMMENT-POLICY-001, make comment-policy-check); heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points, never BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK; never weaken hold labels, the unresolved-thread refusal, oracle-gate, duration or suite gates; add a changelog.d fragment (CHANGELOG_INTERNAL when nothing is user-visible); durable artifacts carry no session or phase labels; cited line numbers are leads, so re-read the code before editing; tests prove behaviour, never wiring or wording.
description: scripts/pr_landing.py's batch checks cannot pass for a batch prepared one member at a time: every receipt must name the final integration head (:913, :921, :1186), member review dispositions must name the final head (:946), member files must stay byte-identical (:1042-1051), final files must equal the member union (:1056-1057, which also rejects net reversions), and the final diff is taken from the start head (:1058-1072). pr_arm.py, the required arming path, has no batch check at all. Rework pr_landing to the v2 contract: receipts checked against the head they were integrated at; dispositions bound to member source ranges; overlap and current-acceptance evidence in place of byte equality; a union that counts recorded fix advances and allows net reversions; the final diff from the merge-base with develop, excluding recorded develop merges. Make pr_arm.py refuse to arm a PR whose head branch is a registered integration branch unless the batch's current acceptance holds at that head, read through the todo-db batch read path.
